ai_batches_sending_claim.name: ai_batches_sending_claim
ai_batches_sending_claim.value: "ai_batches"."status"::text <> 'sending' or ("ai_batches"."claim_id" is not null and "ai_batches"."claimed_at" is not null and "ai_batches"."lease_until" is not null)

delivered_objects_area_or_subdivision.name: delivered_objects_area_or_subdivision
delivered_objects_area_or_subdivision.value: "delivered_objects"."area_id" IS NOT NULL OR "delivered_objects"."subdivision_id" IS NOT NULL

delivered_objects_public_id_prefix.name: delivered_objects_public_id_prefix
delivered_objects_public_id_prefix.value: "delivered_objects"."public_id" ~ ('^' || CASE "delivered_objects"."object_type" WHEN 'spot' THEN 'sp' WHEN 'highlight' THEN 'hl' ELSE 'rg' END || '_')

deliveries_subdivision_data_version_uniq.name: deliveries_subdivision_data_version_unique
deliveries_subdivision_data_version_uniq.where: "deliveries"."data_version" IS NOT NULL AND "deliveries"."subdivision_id" IS NOT NULL

deliveries_area_or_subdivision.name: deliveries_area_or_subdivision
deliveries_area_or_subdivision.value: "deliveries"."area_id" IS NOT NULL OR "deliveries"."subdivision_id" IS NOT NULL

place_images_ai_camera.name: place_images_ai_camera
place_images_ai_camera.value: "place_images"."kind" <> 'ai_illustration' or ("place_images"."camera_position" is not null and "place_images"."camera_height_m" is not null and "place_images"."view_bearing_deg" is not null and "place_images"."camera_tilt_deg" is not null and "place_images"."camera_fov_deg" is not null)

research_hits_serp_ids_when_serp.name: research_hits_serp_ids_when_serp
research_hits_serp_ids_when_serp.value: "research_hits"."origin" <> 'serp' OR ("research_hits"."serp_query_id" IS NOT NULL AND "research_hits"."serp_result_id" IS NOT NULL)

berth_facts_shape_check.name: berth_facts_shape_check
berth_facts_shape_check.value: ("berth_facts"."attribute" is not null and "berth_facts"."value" is not null and "berth_facts"."statement" is null) or ("berth_facts"."attribute" is null and "berth_facts"."value" is null and "berth_facts"."statement" is not null)
